blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, model sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. We evaluate base Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a Qwen2.5-7B model fine-tuned by us using QLoRA, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage shift, overtriage shift, significant shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Across models, counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B model showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, compared with 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base Qwen2.5-7B. Several larger or medical-domain models produced higher rates of significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses showed that aggregate shift rates can hide clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight and clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks across open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 应急部门(ED)的分门别类是一项高优先级的任务,在这项任务中,人口、社会经济和系统信息可能不适当地影响快速性分配。 虽然开放源码大语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地被考虑用于本地和隐私保存的临床决策支持,但尚不清楚模型家族,模型大小,医学领域模型,以及领域适应模型之间的反事实偏差如何不同. 我们提出了对10个开源LLMs儿科急症指数预测的比较反事实审计。 从真实的和手动的临床图案开始,我们构建了对等的反事实变体,这些变体只改变一个注入的人口、社会经济、医疗保健、行为、社会或系统背景变体,同时固定临床演示。 我们使用QLORA、MedGemma的变体、MedLLLaMA2-7B、GPT-OSS-20B和GPT-OSS-120B对一个Quen2.5-7B模型进行了微调。 我们测量任何反事实转移,不足转移,过度转移,重大转移大于一个ESI水平,平均转移,也意味着绝对转移. 在各种模型中,反事实敏感性差别很大,没有随着模型尺寸或医疗领域预先训练而持续下降。 微调的Quen2.5-7B型机车显示整体灵敏度最低,任意转速为5.27%,平均绝对转速为0.0534,而基数为16.02%,0.1706为Quen2.5-7B. 一些较大的或医疗领域的模型产生了较高的重大转变率。 分级和关联性分析显示,总转速率可以掩盖临床上重要的方向性和共同的故障模式. 这些调查结果支持将反事实审计作为一个轻量级和临床可解释的框架,用于在临床部署前比较开源有限责任公司之间的公平风险。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Emergency department (ED) triage determines the priority with which patients receive care, most commonly through the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) - a standardized five-level triage tool that assigns urgency based on patient acuity and expected resource use [ 1 , 2 ] . Growing evidence suggests that this process is not applied equitably across patient populations. Multiple studies have documented disparities in ESI assignment across sex, race/ethnicity, language, and insurance status, indicating that triage scores may reflect not only clinical acuity but also structural inequities embedded in care delivery [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Because ESI is widely used in U.S. EDs [ 3 ] , even small systematic biases can compound into significant population level harms that affect throughput, patient safety, and equity at scale.
blocks.zh: 急诊部门(ED)分诊确定患者接受护理的优先顺序,最常见的方法是通过紧急发热指数(ESI)——一个标准化的五级分诊工具,根据患者的敏锐度和预期资源使用情况分配紧急性[1,2]. 越来越多的证据表明,这一程序在病人中没有得到公平的应用。 多项研究记录了ESI任务在性别、种族/族裔、语言和保险状况方面的差异,表明分数分数不仅可能反映临床成熟性,也可能反映护理服务中存在的结构性不平等[5、6、7]。 由于ESI在美国EDs[3]中被广泛使用,即使是小的系统偏差也会加剧人口水平的重大伤害,影响吞吐量,病人的安全,以及规模的公平.

blocks.en: Open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly attractive for clinical triage because they can be deployed locally, support privacy-preserving inference, and can be fine-tuned on institution-specific documentation. However, models trained on clinical text may learn spurious associations between acuity and non-clinical descriptors, such as race, language, insurance status, housing instability, prior ED use, or primary-care access. These associations may reflect historical bias rather than clinically appropriate evidence. The risk is analogous to well-known examples of algorithmic bias in healthcare, where seemingly neutral proxies can encode inequitable access and lead to systematically different care recommendations [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 开源大语言模型(LLMs)对临床分解越来越有吸引力,因为它们可以在当地部署,支持隐私保护推论,还可以对机构特定文献进行微调. 然而,接受临床文本培训的模型可能学习熟人与非临床描述者之间的虚假联系,如种族、语言、保险状况、住房不稳定、ED之前的使用或初级保健。 这些协会可能反映历史偏见,而不是临床上适当的证据。 这种风险类似于众所周知的保健方面算法偏差的例子,因为看似中立的代理人可以编码不公平的获得机会,并导致系统不同的护理建议[8]。

blocks.en: Recent work has shown that LLMs can reproduce or amplify health inequities when sociodemographic or contextual attributes are added to medical prompts [ 12 , 11 , 13 , 14 ] . However, existing studies have primarily focused on cloud-based LLMs, general medical decision-making, binary or coarse triage tasks, or a narrower set of demographic factors. In contrast, our study compares ten open-source LLMs across model families and sizes, evaluates pediatric five-level ESI prediction, tests a broader set of triage-relevant demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, and system-context variables, and reports clinically directional undertriage and overtriage shifts.
blocks.zh: 近期的研究表明,当社会人口或环境属性被添加到医疗提示中[12、11、13、14]时,法学硕士可以复制或扩大健康不平等。 然而,现有的研究主要集中于云基LLMs,一般医学决策,二进制或粗细的分化任务,或较窄的一组人口因素. 对比之下,我们的研究比较了10个跨模范家庭和规模的开源LLMs,评价了儿科五级ESI预测,测试了一套更广泛的与分类相关的人口、社会经济、医疗保健获取、行为、社会和系统背景变量,并报告了临床方向性营养不足和过度营养转移。

blocks.en: We study this risk in pediatric ED triage using a counterfactual variable injection design focused on triage-relevant factors, such as arrival mode, prior ED use, and ED crowding. The central question is: Does an LLM change its ESI prediction when only demographic, socioeconomic, or triage-contextual information changes and the clinical presentation remains identical? Unlike standard subgroup evaluation, this approach uses each vignette as its own control and avoids conflating case-mix differences with model sensitivity. We evaluate both whether predictions change and whether the change represents undertriage to a less urgent ESI level or overtriage to a more urgent ESI level.
blocks.zh: 我们利用反事实可变注射设计,研究儿科ED分型中的这一风险,重点是与分型相关的因素,例如到达模式、ED使用前和ED拥挤。 中心问题是:当只有人口学、社会经济学或分类文字信息的变化和临床表述仍然相同时,LLM会改变其ESI的预测吗? 与标准分组评价不同,这种方法使用每个vignette作为自己的控制,避免了将大小写差异与模型敏感性混为一谈. 我们既评估预测是否发生变化,又评估变化是否意味着低到不太紧迫的ESI水平,也评估过度到更紧迫的ESI水平。

blocks.en: This paper makes four contributions: • We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric ESI prediction, spanning small and larger general models, medical-domain models, and a domain-adapted Qwen2.5-7B model. • We introduce a single-variable injection protocol that holds the clinical vignette fixed while perturbing triage-relevant demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, and system-context variables. • We evaluate fairness-relevant sensitivity using triage-specific direction-aware metrics, separating undertriage shifts from overtriage shifts and reporting significant ESI changes greater than one level. • We show that larger model size and medical-domain pretraining do not guarantee lower bias; instead, the Qwen2.5-7B model fine-tuned by us using QLoRA had the lowest counterfactual sensitivity across most analyses.
blocks.zh: • 本文件提出了四项意见: 我们提出对10个开源LLMs的比较反事实审计,用于儿科ESI预测,涵盖小型和更大的一般模型,医学领域模型,以及一个经域调整的Quen2.5-7B模型。 我们引入了单一可变注射协议,在干扰与年龄、社会经济、医疗保健、行为、社会和系统关联相关的分类变量的同时,固定临床卷轴。 我们利用分类特定的方向认识度量来评价与公平有关的敏感性,把分解不足的转变与分解过度的转变区分开来,并报告超过一个级别的重大ESI变化。 我们显示,更大的模型尺寸和医疗领域预先训练并不能保证较低的偏差;相反,我们利用QLORA对Quen2.5-7B模型进行微调,在大多数分析中反事实敏感性最低。

blocks.en: We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric ESI prediction, spanning small and larger general models, medical-domain models, and a domain-adapted Qwen2.5-7B model.
blocks.zh: 我们为儿科ESI预测提出了10个开源LLMs的比较反事实审计,涵盖小型和更大的一般模型,医学领域模型,以及一个适合域的Quen2.5-7B模型.

blocks.en: We introduce a single-variable injection protocol that holds the clinical vignette fixed while perturbing triage-relevant demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, and system-context variables.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了单一可变注射协议,在干扰与年龄相关的人口、社会经济、医疗保健、行为、社会和系统关联变量的同时,固定临床维涅特。

blocks.en: We evaluate fairness-relevant sensitivity using triage-specific direction-aware metrics, separating undertriage shifts from overtriage shifts and reporting significant ESI changes greater than one level.
blocks.zh: 我们利用分类特定的方向认识度量来评价与公平有关的敏感性,将分解不足转移和过度转移区分开来,并报告超过一个层次的重大ESI变化。

blocks.en: We show that larger model size and medical-domain pretraining do not guarantee lower bias; instead, the Qwen2.5-7B model fine-tuned by us using QLoRA had the lowest counterfactual sensitivity across most analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,更大的模型尺寸和医疗领域预先训练并不能保证较低的偏差;相反,我们利用QLORA对Quen2.5-7B模型进行微调,在大多数分析中反事实敏感性最低。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Emergency Department Triage and Equity
blocks.zh: II-A 紧急部门

blocks.en: ESI is designed to stratify ED patients into five acuity levels, where ESI 1 is most urgent and ESI 5 is least urgent [ 1 , 2 ] . Despite its widespread use, ESI assignment is imperfect and can vary across nurses, settings, and documentation quality. Sax et al. [ \NoHyper 4 \endNoHyper ] found that mistriage was common across millions of ED encounters and emphasized the need to reduce critical undertriage while improving equity . Disparities in triage are especially important because early acuity assignment can influence waiting time, diagnostic workup, pain treatment, disposition, and downstream outcomes. Studies of adult and pediatric EDs have reported differences in ESI assignment or undertriage by sex, race, ethnicity, primary language, and insurance status [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . These findings motivate auditing AI triage systems not only for overall accuracy, but also for sensitivity to demographic and socioeconomic descriptors.
blocks.zh: ESI旨在将ED患者分解为5个精度级,其中ESI 1最紧急,ESI 5最不紧急[1,2]. 尽管ESI被广泛使用,但任务并不完善,在护士、环境和文件质量方面可能有所不同。 萨克斯等人. [NoHyper 4\end NoHyper]发现误差在数百万ED遭遇中是常见的,并强调需要在改善公平的同时减少严重不足. 分型差异尤其重要,因为早期的分型可影响等待时间、诊断工作、疼痛治疗、处置和下游结果。 对成人和儿科急诊的研究表明,在ESI分配或营养不足方面存在性别、种族、族裔、主要语言和保险状况的差异[5、6、7]。 这些结论促使对AI分类系统进行审计,不仅是为了总体准确性,而且也是为了对人口和社会经济描述的敏感性。

blocks.en: II-B Algorithmic Bias in Healthcare
blocks.zh: II-B 保健方面的算术比喻

blocks.en: Healthcare prediction models can reproduce inequities when labels, features, or proxies reflect unequal access to care. Obermeyer et al. [ \NoHyper 8 \endNoHyper ] showed that a widely used care-management algorithm used healthcare cost as a proxy for illness, thereby assigning lower risk to Black patients with similar or greater illness burden because historical spending was lower. This example is relevant to triage: variables such as insurance, prior ED utilization, primary-care access, and housing instability can be predictive of healthcare trajectories, but they can also encode structural inequities. Fairness metrics such as equal opportunity focus on avoiding missed high-need cases across groups [ 9 ] , while counterfactual fairness asks whether predictions would remain unchanged under a counterfactual change to a protected attribute [ 10 ] . Our audit follows the counterfactual framing, while reporting undertriage and overtriage separately because their clinical consequences differ.
blocks.zh: 当标签、特征或代理反映获得保健的机会不平等时,保健预测模型可能重复不平等现象。 Obermeyer等人著. [#NoHyper 8\end NoHyper]显示,一个广泛使用的护理管理算法将保健费用作为疾病的代名词,从而给有类似或更大疾病负担的黑人病人分配了更低的风险,因为历史支出较低. 这个例子与分类相关:保险、ED使用前、初级保健机会和住房不稳定等变量可以预测保健的轨迹,但它们也可以编码结构性不平等。 机会平等等公平性衡量标准侧重于避免跨群体错失高需求案件[9],反事实公平则询问,在反事实改变为受保护属性的情况下,预测是否会保持不变[10]。 我们的审计遵循反事实框架,同时报告因临床后果不同而导致的不足和过度。

blocks.en: II-C LLM Bias Evaluation in Healthcare
blocks.zh: II-C LLM 保健方面的偏见评价

blocks.en: Recent work shows that LLMs can alter medical recommendations when patient sociodemographic attributes are changed. Omar et al. [ \NoHyper 12 \endNoHyper ] evaluated nine LLMs on 1,000 ED cases, generating 32 variants per case and comparing recommendations across triage priority, testing, treatment, and mental-health assessment tasks. They found medically unsupported differences by race, housing status, income, and LGBTQIA+ identifiers. EquityGuard proposed a contrastive-learning framework to detect and mitigate inequity risk when SDOH factors are inserted into clinical trial matching and medical question-answering inputs [ 13 ] . Their work also used correlation-style analysis to examine whether inequity categories produced similar biased outcomes, which motivated our shared biased-outcome correlation analysis across triage counterfactual variables. Pfohl et al. [ \NoHyper 11 \endNoHyper ] further argued for structured toolboxes to surface health-equity harms in LLMs. In ED triage specifically, Lee et al. [ \NoHyper 14 \endNoHyper ] evaluated LLM robustness and used counterfactual analysis to reveal intersectional sex-by-race preferences in triage models. Our work differs by focusing on locally deployable open-source LLMs for pediatric ESI prediction, testing a broader set of demographic, socioeconomic, access, history, behavioral, social, and system-context variables, and evaluating directionality as undertriage versus overtriage rather than only overall preference shifts.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作显示,当病人的社会人口特征发生变化时,LLMS可以改变医疗建议. 奥马尔等人. [NoHyper 12 end NoHyper]对1000个ED病例评价了9个LLMs,每个病例产生32个变体,并比较了分门别类的优先,测试,治疗和心理健康评估任务的建议. 他们发现在医学上没有根据种族,住房状况,收入,以及LGBTQIA+识别码的差异. EquityGuard提出了一个对比性学习框架,以便在将SDOH因素插入临床试验匹配和医疗问答投入时发现和减轻不平等风险[13]. 他们的工作还利用关联式分析来审查不平等类别是否产生类似的有偏见的结果,这促使我们共同进行有偏见的结果关联性分析,分析涉及分类反事实变量。 Pfohl 等 (英语). [NoHyper 11\\end NoHyper]进一步论证了LLMs中结构化的工具箱来表面健康-权益损害. 具体在ED分类法中,Lee et al. [\NoHyper 14\end NoHyper]评价LLM稳健性,并使用反事实分析来揭示在分型模型中交叉的性与种族偏好. 我们的工作不同之处在于,侧重于用于儿科ESI预测的本地可部署开放源代码LLMs,测试一系列更广泛的人口、社会经济、获取、历史、行为、社会和系统关联变量,并评价方向性为不足与过度,而不仅仅是总体偏好转变。

blocks.en: II-D LLM Domain Adaptation
blocks.zh: II-D LLM 域名适应

blocks.en: Open-source LLMs are appealing for clinical environments because they can reduce latency, infrastructure cost, and exposure of protected health information. Qwen2.5 provides a family of open-source base and instruction-tuned models with improved pretraining and post-training [ 18 ] . Medical foundation models such as MedGemma aim to improve medical text and multimodal reasoning while preserving general capabilities [ 19 ] . GPT-OSS introduced open-source reasoning models with efficient inference and permissive release terms [ 20 ] . Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, including LoRA and QLoRA, make it feasible to adapt models locally using limited GPU resources [ 16 , 17 ] . In this study, we evaluate whether such domain adaptation improves not only accuracy, but also counterfactual stability.
blocks.zh: 开放源代码有限责任公司正在吸引临床环境,因为它们可以降低耐久性、基础设施成本和受保护健康信息的暴露。 Quen2.5提供一套开源基础和教学调试模式,改进了预训和后培训[18]. MedGemma等医疗基础模型旨在改进医疗文本和多式联运推理,同时保持一般能力[19]. GPT-OSS引入了开源推理模型,具有高效推论和允许发布条款[20]. 参数高效的微调方法,包括LORA和QLORA,使得利用有限的GPU资源在当地改造模型成为可行[16,17]. 在这项研究中,我们评价这种领域适应是否不仅提高准确性,而且提高反事实稳定性。

blocks.en: III Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 三. 材料和方法

blocks.en: III-A Study Overview
blocks.zh: 三-A 研究概览

blocks.en: Fig. 1 summarizes the audit pipeline. Each clinical vignette was first evaluated without an injected demographic or socioeconomic context to obtain a baseline ESI prediction. We then generated counterfactual variants by appending exactly one injected variable value to the same vignette. The clinical presentation was otherwise unchanged. Each model predicted ESI for the baseline and injected variants using the same prompt template and deterministic decoding. We compared each injected prediction with the corresponding baseline prediction from the same model and same case, producing a paired counterfactual shift metric.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了审计程序。 每个临床图首先在没有注入人口或社会经济背景的情况下进行评估,以获得基线ESI预测。 然后我们通过将一个精确的注入变量值附加到同一个vignette上来生成反事实变体. 临床介绍没有改变。 每个模型都预测了基线的ESI,并使用相同的即时模板和定型解码的注入变体. 我们把每个注入的预测与来自同一模型和同一病例的相应基线预测进行比较,得出一个对齐的反事实变化度量衡。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the counterfactual audit pipeline. Each clinical vignette is first evaluated without injected context to obtain the model-specific baseline prediction. Single-variable counterfactual variants are then generated by adding one demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context phrase. The same model predicts ESI for each variant. We compute paired shifts relative to the baseline prediction and summarize sensitivity by model, variable domain, variable value, direction, and shared biased-outcome correlation.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1:反事实审计程序概述. 每个临床维涅特首先在不注入上下文的情况下进行评估,以获得模型特定的基线预测. 然后通过增加一个人口、社会经济、医疗保健、行为、社会或系统文字短语,产生单一的可变反事实变体。 同一模型预测每个变体的ESI. 我们根据基线预测计算成对的转变,并按模型、可变域、可变值、方向和共享的偏差结果关联来总结敏感性。

blocks.en: III-B Datasets and External Vignette Evaluation
blocks.zh: 数据集和外部Vignette评价

blocks.en: We evaluated models using two vignette sources. The primary source was the retrospective pediatric ED triage dataset described by Aljohani et al. [ 21 ] . This dataset contains approximately 117,600 de-identified encounters with triage notes, age, nurse-assigned ESI labels, chief complaint, vital signs, physical examination, pivot assessment, and past medical history. For counterfactual and repeated-run analyses, we used a filtered high-quality evaluation set of 352 encounters with substantive clinical information and relatively complete structured documentation.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个阴道源评估模型 主要来源是Aljohani等人描述的追溯性儿科ED分类数据集[21]. 该数据集包含大约117,600次已查明的遭遇,包括分型笔记、年龄、护士指定的ESI标签、主要投诉、生命迹象、身体检查、枢轴评估以及过去医疗史。 为了进行反事实和重复分析,我们使用了一套经过过滤的高质量评价,包括352次接触的实质性临床资料和相对完整的结构文件。

blocks.en: The domain-adapted model, Qwen2.5-7B-FT, was trained using the resources described in Aljohani et al. [ 21 ] , including 245 expert-curated handbook-style ESI vignettes and 117,247 LLM-generated clinical vignettes paired with nurse-assigned ESI reference labels. Cases bypassing routine triage, pre-arrival activation workflows, behavioral-health dominant presentations, and most ESI-1 encounters were excluded to focus on routine ED triage decision support.
blocks.zh: 域适应模型Quen2.5-7B-FT是利用Aljohani等人描述的资源进行训练的. [21],包括245种专家校准手册式ESI vignettes和117,247 LLM生成的临床Vignettes与护士指定的ESI参考标签对齐. 绕过常规分解的病例,到达前激活工作流程,行为健康主导演示,以及ESI-1的大部分遭遇被排除在外,以专注于常规的ED分解决策支持.

blocks.en: To assess whether counterfactual sensitivity patterns generalized beyond the institutional dataset, we also repeated the audit on external ESI Handbook-style vignettes ( n = 245 n=245 ) described by Lu et al. [ 22 ] . These curated scenarios are independent of the institutional evaluation set and provide a standardized triage benchmark. This external vignette analysis does not replace validation on real EHR-derived cases, but it helps test whether model sensitivity to injected demographic, socioeconomic, and contextual variables persists across a non-institutional triage source.
blocks.zh: 为了评估反事实敏感性模式是否在机构数据集之外被普遍化,我们还重复了对Lu等人描述的外部ESI手册式vignettes(n=245n=245)的审计. [22]. 这些经过整理的假设情况独立于机构评价,提供了标准化的分类基准。 这种外部的vignette分析并不能取代对真正的EHR衍生病例的验证,但有助于测试模型对注入的人口、社会经济和背景变量的敏感性是否在非机构分类源中持续存在。

blocks.en: III-C Models
blocks.zh: 三-C型号

blocks.en: We compared ten open-source LLMs across model families and sizes: Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, MedGemma-4B-IT, MedGemma-4B-PT, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, MedGemma-27B-IT, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B, and Qwen2.5-7B-FT. Here, Qwen2.5-7B-FT denotes a Qwen2.5-7B model fine-tuned by us for ESI prediction using the QLoRA adaptation procedure described in Aljohani et al. [ 21 ] . Specifically, Qwen2.5-7B was adapted using expert-curated and silver-standard ESI vignettes, with the silver data split into ten sequential chunks of approximately 11.7k examples each to support stable, continued training and performance tracking. Fine-tune data included expert-curated ESI handbook-style vignettes and silver-standard clinical vignettes paired with nurse-assigned ESI labels. The QLoRA configuration used low-rank adapters on attention and feed-forward projection modules. Training used a fixed random seed, prompt masking so that loss was applied only to the assistant ESI label, and label-scoring inference over the five candidate labels ESI-1 through ESI-5.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了10个跨模范家庭和大小的开源LLMs:Quen2.5-7B,Quen2.5-14B-指令,MedGemma-4B-IT,MedGemma-4B-PT,MedGemma-27B-Text-IT,MedGemma-27B-IT,MedLLAMA2-7B,GPT-OSS-20B,GPT-OSS-120B,以及Quen2.5-7B-FT. 这里,Quen2.5-7B-FT表示一种由我们用Aljohani等人所述的QLORA适应程序对ESI预测进行微调的Quen2.5-7B模型。 [21]. 具体地说,Quen2.5-7B采用专家精准和银质标准ESI vignettes进行改造,银质数据分为10个连续块,每个大约11.7k例,以支持稳定,持续的培训和性能跟踪. 微调数据包括经专家验证的ESI手册式的Vignette和银标准临床Vignette与护士指定的ESI标签对齐. QLORA配置在注意点上采用了低级适配器和feed-forward投影模块. 训练使用固定随机种子,即时遮盖,使损失仅适用于助理ESI标签,并通过ESI-5对五个候选标签ESI-1进行标签评分推论.

blocks.en: TABLE I: Counterfactual variable families and categories used for single-variable injection.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:反事实可变家庭和用于单变量注射的类别.

blocks.en: III-D Counterfactual Variable Injection
blocks.zh: 三-D 反事实变量注入

blocks.en: Each original clinical vignette was first evaluated without demographic or socioeconomic context. We then generated paired counterfactual variants by inserting exactly one variable phrase while keeping the clinical presentation fixed. Table I lists the variable families and injected categories.
blocks.zh: 每个原始的临床卷饼首先在没有人口或社会经济背景的情况下进行评估。 然后我们通过插入一个精确的可变短语,同时保持临床演示的固定,生成对等的反事实变体. 图表 我列出了可变的家族和注入的类别.

blocks.en: For each vignette x i x_{i} , we created one baseline input and a set of counterfactual inputs. The baseline input contained only the clinical vignette. Each counterfactual input appended one injected context phrase: x i ​ j = x i ⊕ c j , x_{ij}=x_{i}\oplus c_{j}, where c j c_{j} is a single variable-value phrase, such as Language: Requires interpreter at triage or Insurance Status: Uninsured; no coverage for medical services . Only one variable value was added at a time. We did not alter symptoms, vital signs, physical examination findings, mental status, or expected resource needs. This design isolates whether the model prediction changes in response to non-clinical or contextual information rather than clinical severity.
blocks.zh: 对于每个 vignette xi x_{i},我们创建了一个基线输入和一组反事实输入. 基线输入只包含临床卷轴。 每个反事实输入都附加了一个注入语境的短语:x i j = x i ⊕ c j , x _{ i j }= x _{ i }\ plus plus plus j ,其中 c j _{ } j 是一个单变量的短语,例如 Language: 需要按分门别类或保险状况提供翻译: 没有保险;没有医疗服务保险。 一次只增加了一个可变值. 我们没有改变症状、生命迹象、身体检查结果、精神状况或预期的资源需求。 这种设计隔离了模型预测是否因非临床或背景信息而改变,而不是临床严重性.

blocks.en: III-E Prompt Template and Output Parsing
blocks.zh: 三-E 快速模板和输出解析

blocks.en: All counterfactual experiments used the same triage prompt template as in table II . The injected variant differed from the baseline only by the presence of the Additional Patient Context block. The prompt instructed the model to use clinical severity only and to ignore non-clinical attributes such as race, language, insurance, socioeconomic status, housing, and other SDOH variables. Therefore, prediction shifts under injected conditions indicate sensitivity to the injected phrase rather than a change in the clinical facts. For generative inference, we used deterministic decoding with do_sample=False . This choice reduces random output variation so that measured differences are attributable to the injected context rather than sampling noise.
blocks.zh: 所有反事实实验都使用了与表二相同的分解速率模板。 注入的变体仅因存在附加患者上下文块而与基线不同. 即时指令模型只使用临床严重性,忽略非临床属性,如种族,语言,保险,社会经济地位,住房等SDOH变量. 因此,在注射条件下的预测变化表明对注射语的敏感性,而不是临床事实的变化. 在基因推论中,我们用 do_sample=False 进行定型解码。 这种选择减少了随机输出的变异,因此测量到的差异可归因于注入的上下文而不是取样噪音.

blocks.en: III-F Metrics
blocks.zh: 三-F计量

blocks.en: Let y ^ i ​ 0 \hat{y}_{i0} denote the baseline ESI prediction for case i i without injected context, and let y ^ i ​ j \hat{y}_{ij} denote the prediction after injecting variable condition j j . Because ESI 1 is most urgent and ESI 5 is least urgent, a positive change means a lower acuity assignment. Δ ​ ESI i ​ j = y ^ i ​ j − y ^ i ​ 0 . \Delta\mathrm{ESI}_{ij}=\hat{y}_{ij}-\hat{y}_{i0}. (1) We define a counterfactual shift as Δ ​ ESI i ​ j ≠ 0 \Delta\mathrm{ESI}_{ij}\neq 0 . Directional metrics are: Undertriage ​ Shift \displaystyle\mathrm{Undertriage\ Shift} = ℙ ⁡ ( Δ ​ ESI i ​ j > 0 ) , \displaystyle=\mathbb{P}(\Delta\mathrm{ESI}_{ij}>0), (2) Overtriage ​ Shift \displaystyle\mathrm{Overtriage\ Shift} = ℙ ⁡ ( Δ ​ ESI i ​ j < 0 ) , \displaystyle=\mathbb{P}(\Delta\mathrm{ESI}_{ij}<0), (3) Significant ​ Shift \displaystyle\mathrm{Significant\ Shift} = ℙ ⁡ ( | Δ ​ ESI i ​ j | > 1 ) . \displaystyle=\mathbb{P}(|\Delta\mathrm{ESI}_{ij}|>1). (4) We also compute mean shift 𝔼 ⁡ [ Δ ​ ESI ] \mathbb{E}[\Delta\mathrm{ESI}] and mean absolute shift 𝔼 ⁡ [ | Δ ​ ESI | ] \mathbb{E}[|\Delta\mathrm{ESI}|] . Positive mean shift indicates a tendency toward undertriage; negative mean shift indicates a tendency toward overtriage. For stratified analyses, we report per-category shift rate, no-change rate, undertriage shift, and overtriage shift.

(4)我们还计算E 的正值班 [\\ ESI]\ mathbb{E} [\ Delta\ mathrm{ ESI}] 和表示绝对班 E \ mathbb{ E} [\ Delta\ mathrm{ ESI}] 。 积极平均转移表明出现营养不足的趋势;消极平均转移表明过度营养的趋势。 就分级分析而言,我们报告每个类别的转移率、无变化率、不足转移和过度转移。

blocks.en: III-G Correlation Analysis of Shared Biased Outcomes
blocks.zh: 三-G 共享偏差结果关联分析

blocks.en: Following EquityGuard [ 13 ] , we evaluated whether different injected categories tended to fail on the same cases. For each pair of injected category values, we assigned a score of + 1 +1 if both values produced the same wrong ESI prediction, − 1 -1 if one value produced a wrong prediction and the other did not, and 0 0 if both values preserved the correct or unchanged prediction. For example, if adding commercial insurance and adding private-vehicle arrival both changed the same case from the baseline ESI prediction to the same incorrect ESI level, the pair received + 1 +1 for that case. If only one of the two injections changed the prediction, the pair received − 1 -1 ; if neither changed the prediction, the pair received 0 0 . We averaged these scores across encounters to obtain value-level pairwise associations, where positive values indicate shared failure modes , negative values indicate discordant or inconsistent errors , and values near zero indicate little systematic relationship. We then aggregated value-level scores to the variable level by averaging all category-value pairs belonging to each pair of injected variables.
blocks.zh: 继公平担保[13]之后,我们评估了不同注入类别在相同情况下是否倾向于失败。 对于每对注入的类别值,如果两个值产生相同的错误ESI预测,我们分配了+1+1的分数;如果一个值产生错误的预测,而另一个没有,我们分配了−1-1的分数;如果两个值都保持正确的或不变的预测,我们分配了0的分数. 例如,如果增加商业保险和增加私人车辆到达,则从基线ESI预测改为相同的不正确的ESI水平,则该对子收到该案例的+1+1。 如果两次注射中只有一次改变了预测,则对子得到−1–1;如果两次都没有改变预测,则对子得到0–0. 我们通过交叉接触来估计这些分数,以获得值级对等关联,其中正值表示共享失败模式,负值表示不一致或不一致错误,接近零值则表示几乎没有系统性关系。 然后,我们通过对每一对注入变量的所有类别值对进行平均计算,将数值等级的得分汇总到可变水平。

blocks.en: III-H Interpretation: Bias Versus Clinically Relevant Context
blocks.zh: 口译: 临床相关背景

blocks.en: Not every counterfactual shift should be interpreted identically. Demographic and socioeconomic identifiers such as race, language, insurance, income, and housing should not change ESI unless they alter clinical severity or available history. In contrast, variables such as EMS pre-notification, recent hospitalization, or domestic safety concerns may sometimes be clinically meaningful if they provide legitimate acuity information. We therefore use the term counterfactual sensitivity for all shifts and reserve potential bias for shifts driven by non-clinical or clinically unjustified attributes. Direction matters: undertriage shifts are generally more safety-critical, whereas overtriage shifts may represent conservative escalation but can still create resource inequity.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个相反事实的转变都应作同样的解释。 人口和社会经济特征,如种族、语言、保险、收入和住房,除非改变临床严重程度或现有历史,否则不应改变ESI。 与此相反,诸如环管系统预先通知、最近住院治疗或国内安全考虑等变量,如果能提供合理的精密信息,有时可能具有临床意义。 因此,我们对所有转变都使用反事实敏感性这一术语,并为非临床或临床上不合理属性驱动的转变保留潜在偏差。 方向事项:不足转移通常更加安全,而过度转移可能代表保守的升级,但仍然会造成资源不平等。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: IV-A Repeated-Run Stability
blocks.zh: IV-A 反复运行稳定

blocks.en: Before auditing bias, we tested repeated-run output stability on the same test set. As shown in Table III , several models were perfectly deterministic under fixed decoding settings , including Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, MedGemma-27B-IT, MedLLaMA2-7B, and GPT-OSS-120B. MedGemma-4B-PT was unstable, with only 3.72% exact prediction consistency and mean pairwise absolute difference of 1.52; we therefore excluded it from later bias analyses because instability could confound true counterfactual sensitivity with output noise.
blocks.zh: 在审计偏向之前,我们在同一套测试中测试了重复运行的产出稳定性. 如表三所示,若干型号在固定解码设置下完全具有确定性,包括Fine-tuned Quen2.5-7B,Quen2.5-7B,Quen2.5-14B-Instruct,MedGemma-27B-Text-IT,MedGemma-27B-IT,MedLLAMA2-7B,以及GPT-OSS-120B。 MedGemma-4B-PT不稳定,精确预测一致性只有3.72%,平均对比绝对差1.52;因此,我们将其排除在后来的偏差分析之外,因为不稳定性可能会将真实的反事实敏感性与输出噪声混淆.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Repeated-run stability across five runs on the same test set ( n = 352 n=352 ).
blocks.zh: 表三:同一套测试(n = 352 n = 352)上的5个以上的重复运行稳定性。

blocks.en: IV-B Aggregate Counterfactual Sensitivity in Non-Clinical Domains
blocks.zh: IV-B 非临床领域反事实敏感性

blocks.en: Table IV summarizes no-change, undertriage-shift, overtriage-shift, and significant-shift rates for the two domains most appropriate for aggregate bias evaluation: demographic variables and socioeconomic/living-condition variables. We report aggregate averages only for these domains because their injected attributes, such as race/ethnicity, language, insurance, neighborhood deprivation, and housing status, should not change ESI when the clinical presentation is held fixed. Other domains include mixed contextual variables, such as EMS pre-notification, recent hospitalization, prior ED utilization, and domestic safety concerns, which may sometimes carry clinically relevant acuity information; therefore, those variables are analyzed separately in the stratified results rather than averaged into the main aggregate bias metric.
blocks.zh: 表四汇总了两个领域最适于总体偏差评价的无变化率、过渡率、过渡率:人口变量和社会经济/生活条件变量。 我们只报告这些领域的汇总平均值,因为它们的注入属性,如种族/族裔、语言、保险、邻里贫困以及住房状况,在临床展示固定时不应改变ESI。 其他领域包括多种背景变量,如环管系统预先通知、最近住院、ED使用前、以及国内安全问题,这些变量有时可能包含与临床相关的早期信息;因此,这些变量在分层结果中单独分析,而不是平均地计入主要的汇总偏差指标。

blocks.en: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest aggregate sensitivity in these non-clinical domains, preserving predictions in 95.37% of demographic injections and 94.89% of socioeconomic/living-condition injections. For demographic variables, Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B had 3.00% undertriage shifts, 1.62% overtriage shifts, and no significant shifts. For socioeconomic and living-condition variables, it had 3.55% undertriage shifts, 1.56% overtriage shifts, and only 0.07% significant shifts.
blocks.zh: 精细的Quen2.5-7B显示这些非临床领域的总敏感度最低,在95.37%的人口注射和94.89%的社会经济/生活条件注射中保持了预测。 就人口变量而言,Fine-tuned Qun2.5-7B有3.00 %的不足转移,1.62%的过度转移,没有显著的转移。 就社会经济和生活条件变量而言,它有3.55%的营养不足转移,1.56%的营养过剩转移,只有0.07%的重大转移。

blocks.en: In comparison, Qwen2.5-7B produced substantially more shifts, with no-change rates of 80.80% for demographic variables and 83.17% for socioeconomic/living-condition variables. Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and GPT-OSS models showed larger sensitivity in some domains, particularly overtriage shifts. Several medical-domain models also showed high sensitivity despite medical pretraining; for example, MedGemma-27B-IT had no-change rates near 59% and significant-shift rates near 29% across these two non-clinical domains.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Quen2.5-7B的变动率大为增加,人口变量的变动率为80.80%,社会经济/生活条件变量的变动率为83.17%。 Quen2.5-14B-指令模型和GPT-OSS模型在一些领域显示出更大的敏感性,特别是过度转移。 一些医学领域模型也显示出高度的敏感性,尽管有医学预训;例如,MedGemma-27B-IT在这两个非临床领域的无变化率接近59%,而且大幅转变率接近29%。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Aggregate counterfactual sensitivity by variable domain. Values are percentages. Lower undertriage, overtriage, and significant-shift rates are better; higher no-change is better.
blocks.zh: 表格 四:按可变域分列的总反事实敏感性. 数值为百分比。 营养不足率、过度营养率和大幅变化率较好;没有变化率较高更好。

blocks.en: IV-C Proxy-Variable Injection Across All Domains
blocks.zh: IV-C 横跨所有域的可变代理注射

blocks.en: Table V summarizes proxy-variable injection using any-shift rate, negative shift, positive shift, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B had the lowest any-shift rate among all evaluated models at 5.27% and the lowest mean absolute shift at 0.0534 . Qwen2.5-7B had a 16.02% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.1706. GPT-OSS-120B shifted in 40.75% of cases, while MedGemma-27B-IT shifted in 41.18% of cases with mean absolute shift of 0.84, indicating frequent large ESI changes. These results suggest that domain adaptation can reduce counterfactual sensitivity more effectively than simply increasing model size or using medical-domain pretraining.
blocks.zh: 表五总结了使用任何转移率,负转移率,正转移率,正转移率,均值转移率,均值绝对转移率的可代理变量注入率. 微调的Quen2.5-7B在所有被评价的模型中,任何班次的班次率最低,为5.27%,平均绝对班次最低,为0.0534。 Wen2.5-7B的转速为16.02%,平均绝对转速为0.1706。 GPT-OSS-120B在40.75%的病例中转移,而MedGemma-27B-IT在41.18%的病例中转移,平均绝对变化为0.84,表明ESI频繁发生较大变化. 这些结果表明,比起简单地增加模型大小或使用医学领域预训,域位适应可以更有效地降低反事实敏感性.

blocks.en: TABLE V: Overall proxy-variable injection sensitivity. Positive shift means urgency decrease/undertriage; negative shift means urgency increase/overtriage.
blocks.zh: 表五:总的可替代注射敏感性。 积极转变意味着紧迫性减少/不足;消极转变意味着紧迫性增加/过度。

blocks.en: IV-D Stratified Demographic and Socioeconomic Effects
blocks.zh: IV-D 分类的人口和社会经济影响

blocks.en: As shown in Table VI , stratified results showed that Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B had small demographic effects. Race/ethnicity shift rates ranged from 3.41% to 4.83%, and language shift rates were 6.25% for English and 5.40% for non-English . There was no evidence of increased undertriage for non-English cases relative to English cases in the fine-tuned model. In contrast, Qwen2.5-7B was more sensitive to demographic perturbations. Non-English injection produced a 25.85% shift rate for Qwen2.5-7B, compared with 19.03% for English. The direction also changed: undertriage decreased from 14.20% to 8.81%, whereas overtriage increased from 4.83% to 17.05%, indicating a strong conservative shift for non-English patients.
blocks.zh: 如表六所示,分级结果显示,微调的Quen2.5-7B对人口影响较小。 种族/族裔的轮班率从3.41%到4.83%不等,英语的轮班率为6.25%,非英语的轮班率为5.40%。 没有证据表明,在微调模型中,非英语案件比英语案件少。 相比之下,Quen2.5-7B对人口扰动更为敏感. 非英语注射产生25.85%的Quen2.5-7B转速率,而英语的转速率为19.03%. 方向也发生了变化:营养不足率从14.20%下降到8.81%,而营养过剩率则从4.83%上升到17.05%,这表明非英国患者的保守倾向强烈转变.

blocks.en: Socioeconomic effects were also reduced by fine-tuning but not eliminated . For Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, commercial insurance had the largest socioeconomic shift rate at 8.52%, mostly undertriage shifts (7.67%). Low-deprivation neighborhood injection increased undertriage relative to high-deprivation injection (5.11% versus 1.14%), suggesting a potential harmful direction that requires further review. Housing instability produced lower undertriage but higher overtriage than stable housing, suggesting conservative escalation. For Qwen2.5-7B, effects were larger: stable housing was associated with 18.18% undertriage and only 0.57% overtriage, whereas housing instability shifted toward overtriage (15.62%). These differences, summarized in Table VI , would be hidden if only aggregate any-shift rates were reported.
blocks.zh: 通过微调但未能消除,也减少了社会经济影响。 对于精细调整的Quen2.5-7B,商业保险的社会经济轮班率最高,为8.52%,大多数是低价轮班(7.67%)。 与高贫困注射相比,低贫困区注射率增加了不足(5.11%对1.14%),这表明潜在的有害方向需要进一步审查。 住房不稳定导致比稳定的住房少但多,这表明保守的升级。 就Quen2.5-7B而言,影响更大:稳定的住房与18.18%的不足和0.57%的过度住房有关,而住房不稳定转向过度住房(15.62%)。 表六概述的这些差异,如果只报告任何变动费率的合计数,就会被掩盖。

blocks.zh: 表格 六:微调和基础Qwen2.5-7B模型的分级反事实结果. 数值为百分比。

blocks.en: TABLE VII: External vignette sensitivity on the ESI Handbook vignette set. Values are percentages. Lower undertriage, overtriage, and significant-shift rates indicate lower counterfactual sensitivity; higher no-change is better.
blocks.zh: 表七:ESI手册 vignette集上的外部花纹灵敏度. 数值为百分比。 低于标准、超标准以及大幅变动率表明反事实敏感性较低;高于标准的情况更好。

Positive values indicate shared wrong outcomes, negative values indicate discordant correctness, and values near zero indicate weak association.

blocks.en: IV-E Healthcare-Access, Behavioral, Social, and System-Context Effects
blocks.zh: IV-E 获得保健、行为、社会和系统环境影响

blocks.en: As shown in Table VI , healthcare-access and patient-history variables often produced shifts that may be clinically interpretable . For Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, recent hospitalization within 30 days produced 6.82% shifts, with higher overtriage (4.83%) than undertriage (1.99%), suggesting cautious escalation. Multiple recent ED visits produced 7.10% shifts, mostly undertriage (5.11%). Lack of primary-care access produced fewer shifts than established primary care, with 3.41% undertriage and 1.42% overtriage.
blocks.zh: 如表六所示,获得保健服务和病人历史的变数往往产生可临床解释的转变。 对精细调整的Quen2.5-7B来说,最近30天内的住院导致6.82%的轮班,超重(4.83%)高于低重(1.99%),这表明谨慎的升级。 最近的多次ED访问产生了7.10%的班次,大多数是不足(5.11%)。 缺乏初级保健服务导致的轮班比既定的初级保健少,有3.41%的营养不足,1.42%的营养过剩。

blocks.en: Behavioral, social, and system-context variables produced the highest fine-tuned sensitivity among the four domains . Arrival by ambulance with EMS pre-notification produced a 10.51% shift rate in Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, while private-vehicle arrival produced 8.81%. Overnight/weekend high-volume surge produced the highest fine-tuned shift rate (13.35%) and was associated with 10.51% undertriage shifts, which is a potential concern because system strain should not reduce urgency assignment for clinically identical patients. Domestic safety concerns produced no increase in shift rate relative to safe home environment, but shifted direction from undertriage toward overtriage. Qwen2.5-7B showed much stronger sensitivity: EMS pre-notification produced 32.95% shifts, domestic safety concerns produced 34.66% shifts, and the latter was overwhelmingly overtriage (32.95%). Overall, these stratified results separate clearer non-clinical bias signals from context-sensitive variables where clinical review is needed to distinguish appropriate acuity response from proxy-driven bias.
blocks.zh: 行为、社会和系统背景变量在四个领域产生了最高的微调敏感性。 乘救护车抵达并事先通知EMS,在Fine-tuned Quen2.5-7B中产生10.51%的轮班率,而私人车辆的轮班率则达到8.81%。 超夜/周末大量涌出,产生最高的微调转速率(13.35%),并伴有10.51%的微调转速,这是一个潜在的问题,因为系统紧张不应减少临床相同病人的紧急分配。 与安全的家庭环境相比,国内安全方面的关切没有导致轮班率上升,而是将班次从低潮转向过度。 Quen2.5-7B显示的敏感性要强得多:环管系统预先通知产生32.95%的班次,国内安全考虑产生34.66%的班次,后者绝大多数是超速(32.95%)。 总体而言,这些分层结果将更清晰的非临床偏差信号与对上下文敏感的变量分开,这些变量需要临床审查,以区分适当的敏锐反应和代理驱动的偏差.

blocks.en: IV-F External Vignette Sensitivity
blocks.zh: IV-F 外部维格内特敏感性

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the counterfactual sensitivity patterns generalized beyond the institutional evaluation set, we repeated the audit on the external ESI handbook-style vignettes. As shown in Table VII , the fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B model remained among the most stable models across demographic and socioeconomic domains . The fine-tuned model preserved the baseline prediction in near 96% of injected cases and produced nearly zero significant shifts across all external vignette domains. In contrast, several base and medical open-weight models showed larger counterfactual sensitivity, especially MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, which had high rates of significant shifts. These results suggest that fine-tuning improved robustness not only on the institutional test set but also on external triage vignettes.
blocks.zh: 为了评价是否超越机构评价范围普遍采用反事实敏感性模式,我们重复了对外部ESI手册式卷轴的审计。 如表七所示,经过微调的Quen2.5-7B模型仍然是人口和社会经济领域最稳定的模型之一。 微调模型在近96%的注射病例中保留了基线预测,并在所有外部紫外线领域产生了近乎零的显著变化。 相比之下,一些基础模型和医学开放量模型显示出更大的反事实灵敏度,特别是MedGemma-27B-Text-IT,其显著转变率很高. 这些结果表明,不仅在体制测试中,而且在外部分辨中,都对改进的稳健性进行了微调。

blocks.en: IV-G Shared Biased-Outcome Correlation
blocks.zh: IV-G 共有的偏见结果关联

blocks.en: Domain adaptation reduced both direct counterfactual sensitivity and shared biased-outcome coupling across inequity categories. As shown in Fig. 2 , Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B had a smaller average absolute off-diagonal correlation score than Qwen2.5-7B (0.0366 vs. 0.0849), indicating fewer clustered failure patterns across injected variables.
blocks.zh: 各地的适应既降低了直接的反事实敏感性,也降低了不平等类别之间共同的有偏见的结果结合。 如图2所示,Fine-tuned Quen2.5-7B的平均绝对离对角相对比Qwen2.5-7B(0.0366 vs.0.0849)小,表明各注入变量的集群故障模式较少.

blocks.en: For Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, most variable-level associations were close to zero, with scores ranging from − 0.0845 -0.0845 to 0.0249 0.0249 . The strongest positive association was between Arrival Mode and Arrival Time ( 0.0249 0.0249 ), while the strongest negative association was between ED Crowding and Urban-Rural Context ( − 0.0845 -0.0845 ). These small magnitudes suggest limited systematic co-occurrence of biased outcomes.
blocks.zh: 对于Fine-tuned Quen2.5-7B,大多数可变级协会接近于零,得分范围从−0.0845-0.0845到0.02490.0249. 最强的积极联系是在抵达模式和抵达时间(0.0249 0.0249)之间,而最强的积极联系是在ED Crowding和城乡背景(−0.0845 - 0.0845)之间。 这些小的幅度表明,有偏见的结果的系统性共同发生有限。

blocks.en: In contrast, Qwen2.5-7B showed stronger and more structured associations, with scores ranging from − 0.2280 -0.2280 to 0.0369 0.0369 . The strongest negative variable-level association was between Arrival Mode and Substance Use ( − 0.2280 -0.2280 ), and several strong value-level discordant pairs involved Domestic Safety = concerns about safety at home , including Primary Care Access = established PCP ( − 0.4290 -0.4290 ) and Insurance Status = fully insured ( − 0.4233 -0.4233 ). These results suggest that the base model reacted less consistently to injected contextual factors, whereas fine-tuning reduced cross-category clustering of biased outcomes.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Qwen2.5-7B表现出更强壮,结构更完善的关联,得分从−0.2280-0.2280到0.0369不等. 0.0369 (英语). 最强的负可变级关联是抵达模式与物质使用(−0.2280-0.2280)之间,若干极具价值级的不和对夫妇涉及家庭安全=对家庭安全的关切,包括初级保健获取=已确定的五氯苯酚(−0.4290-0.4290)和保险状况=完全保险(−0.4233-0.4233)。 这些结果表明,基准模型对注入背景因素的反应不太一致,而微调则减少了对有偏见结果的跨类别分组。

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: Positive-control clinical injections. Values are percentages. Uptriage indicates a shift toward a more urgent ESI level after adding clinically relevant information.
blocks.zh: 表八:正控临床注射. 数值为百分比。 上升表明,在增加了临床相关信息之后,向更紧迫的ESI水平转变。

blocks.en: IV-H Positive-Control Clinical Injection
blocks.zh: IV-H 正控制临床注射

blocks.en: Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B remained responsive to clinically relevant information, indicating that its lower bias sensitivity was not simply due to ignoring all added context. To test whether low counterfactual shift rates reflected fairness robustness rather than model inertia, we performed a positive-control experiment by injecting clinically relevant findings that should change ESI acuity. These injections included immediate life-saving needs, high-risk neurologic or respiratory findings, severe pain, and increased resource needs. Unlike demographic or socioeconomic injections, these clinical additions should appropriately move predictions toward a more urgent ESI level when the baseline vignette does not already reflect that severity.
blocks.zh: 微调的Quen2.5-7B仍然对临床相关信息做出响应,表明其较低的偏差敏感度不仅仅是因为忽略了所有新增的上下文. 为了检验低反事实转移率是否反映公平性而不是模型惯性,我们进行了一个正控制实验,在临床上注入相关结果,从而改变ESI的精度。 这些注射包括眼下救生需要、高风险神经或呼吸系统发现、剧烈疼痛和增加资源需求。 与人口或社会经济注射不同,这些临床补充应适当地将预测推向更紧迫的ESI水平,因为基线维涅特尚未反映这种严重程度。

blocks.en: As shown in Table VIII , Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B appropriately uptriaged nearly all cases after injections indicating active seizure or cyanosis requiring bag-mask ventilation (100.00% shift, all toward higher acuity). It also showed high clinically appropriate uptriage for toxic appearance with poor perfusion (94.32%), severe respiratory distress with hypoxia (92.61%), severe pain (89.77%), lethargy (89.49%), and new confusion (89.49%). The resource-use control produced a smaller but interpretable shift rate (44.60%), consistent with the expectation that resource-use information should mainly affect lower-acuity ESI-4/5 cases rather than cases already assigned ESI-3 or higher. These results suggest that Fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B did not simply suppress all injected information; instead, it was less sensitive to non-clinical bias variables while remaining responsive to clinically meaningful acuity cues.
blocks.zh: 如表八所示,经过精细调整的Quen2.5-7B在注射后,几乎所有病例都经过适当调整,表明有活性癫痫或氰化症需要袋盖通风(100.0%的转变,所有病例都朝更高的高度转变)。 它还表明,在临床上对输液不良(94.32%)、缺氧严重呼吸困难(92.61%)、严重疼痛(89.77%)、麻痹(89.49%)和新的混乱(89.49%)的毒性外观进行高适的恢复。 资源使用控制产生了一个较小但可解释的转移率(44.60%),这与资源使用信息应主要影响到低清晰度ESI-4/5案例而不是已经分配给ESI-3或更高层次的案例的期望是一致的。 这些结果显示,Fine-tuned Quen2.5-7B并不只是压制所有注入的信息;相反,它对非临床偏差变量的敏感度较低,同时对临床上有意义的精度提示保持响应.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented a comparative counterfactual audit of open-source LLMs for pediatric ED triage. By injecting one variable at a time into identical clinical vignettes, we measured whether ESI predictions changed in response to demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, and system-context information. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B model showed the lowest sensitivity in the clearest non-clinical bias domains, while several base, larger, and medical-domain open-source models were more sensitive. Direction-aware analysis showed that aggregate shift rates can hide important undertriage and overtriage patterns, especially when variables with different clinical interpretations are averaged together. Positive-control injections showed that the fine-tuned model remained responsive to clinically relevant acuity information, suggesting its lower bias sensitivity was not simply due to ignoring added context.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了对儿科ED分类开源LLMs的比较反事实审计。 通过一次将一个变量注入相同的临床阴道,我们测量ESI预测是否因人口、社会经济、医疗保健、行为、社会和系统关联信息而发生变化。 微调的Qwen2.5-7B模型在最清晰的非临床偏差域中表现出最低的灵敏度,而几个碱基,更大,医学领域的开源模型则更为灵敏. 方向感知分析显示,总位移率可以隐藏重要的底细和过量规律,特别是当临床解释不同的变量平均在一起时. 正控注射表明,微调模型仍然对临床相关早期信息作出反应,表明其较低的偏差敏感度不仅仅是因为忽略了新增上下文.

blocks.en: This study has several limitations. First, the institutional evaluation set was filtered for substantive documentation and may not represent sparse or ambiguous real-world triage notes. Second, nurse-assigned ESI labels are operational reference standards rather than perfect ground truth, and the fine-tuned model may inherit label bias. Third, the injected variables were templated phrases, while real notes may express demographic, socioeconomic, and contextual information more subtly. Fourth, most experiments tested single-variable perturbations; future work should examine intersectional combinations. Overall, these findings support counterfactual injection as a lightweight, interpretable, and clinically meaningful component of fairness evaluation for locally deployable LLM triage systems.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有若干局限性。 首先,机构评价集被过滤为实质性文件,不一定是稀疏或模棱两可的现实世界分类说明。 其次,护士指定的ESI标签是操作参考标准,而不是完美的地面真理,精细的模型可能继承标签偏差. 第三,注入的变量是模板化的短语,而真实的注释可能更暗地表达人口、社会经济和背景信息。 第四,大多数实验测试了单变量扰动;今后的工作应当检查交叉组合. 总体而言,这些结论支持反事实注射,作为当地可部署的LLM分类系统的公平评价中一个轻量级、可解释性和临床意义的组成部分。
